name: La Rosa Phase 5 By Dubai Properties
paymentPlan: 10%: Down payment at sales launch; 40%: During construction; 50%: On handover
overview: A fresh chapter in the dynamic story of the city's real estate can be found withLa Rosa Phase 5 By Dubai Properties. This construction is the most recent addition to the highly regarded Villanova project, brought to you by Dubai Properties. La Rosa Phase 5 By Dubai Properties offers opulent 3- and 4-bedroom townhouses with an elegant fusion of modern style and opulent facilities, carrying on the successful path of its four earlier phases.
